name: duplicates-android-deepsec-workspace
description: DeepSec scanning workspace for Duplicates Android

scripts.deepsec:process: deepsec process --project-id duplicates-android --agent codex --model gpt-6.1-sol --thinking-level medium --concurrency 1
scripts.deepsec:revalidate: deepsec revalidate --project-id duplicates-android --agent codex --model gpt-6.1-sol --thinking-level medium --min-severity HIGH --concurrency 1
scripts.deepsec:report: pnpm run deepsec:scan && pnpm run deepsec:process && pnpm run deepsec:export
